title: sarcococca taiwaniana
intro: Sarcococca taiwaniana, commonly known as Chinese Box or Fragrant Box, is a flowering plant species in the family Buxaceae. It is valued for its sweetly fragrant flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, fever, and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Sarcococca taiwaniana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use as an antiseptic and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, such as sarcococca alkaloids and benzophenanthridine alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
